setup: A non-production account under accounts/<domain>/ with profile.json, an active price list in the account currency with at least two active products, and a test deal with a contact, in an open stage, whose quote already has one catalog line. Replace <deal> and <product> in the prompts with real names from that account. For the time-discount evals, also a deal whose quote has two catalog lines, one of them already discounted, and a deal in an end-of-flow stage (<closed-deal>).

evals.prompt: Add 3 units of <product> to the quote of the deal <deal>.
evals.expected_output: Finds the deal and the product in the right price list, previews, asks for a yes, saves, and reports the saved total.
expectations: Uses scripts/quote.js (deals/show/search/preview/apply), never a hand-made PATCH of the deal
Shows the preview (lines and the server's new total) and waits for an explicit yes before apply
After saving, the new line has product and pricebookEntry, is not virtual, and has quantity 3
The line that was already in the quote is still there with the same uuid
The total it reports is the one apply returned

evals.prompt: Agrégale 2 <product> a la cotización del negocio <deal> con 10% de descuento.
evals.expected_output: Same flow, answered in Spanish, with discountRate 0.1 and discountAmount 0 on the new line.
expectations: Answers in Spanish
Sends discountRate as 0.1 (a decimal), not 10
The saved line carries discountRate 0.1 and discountAmount 0

evals.prompt: Add a 'Custom onboarding package' to the quote of <deal> for 500.
evals.expected_output: Searches the catalog, finds nothing, tells the user the product is not in the price list and does not create a made-up line.
expectations: Searches the catalog before anything else
Does not write a virtual line or invent a price-list entry
Explains the options in plain words (create the product in the catalog, or a custom line in the app)

evals.prompt: Change the quantity of the first line of <deal>'s quote to 5 and remove the service charge.
evals.expected_output: Updates the line by uuid; explains the service charge is automatic and only dismisses it if the user insists after hearing that.
expectations: Identifies the line by uuid from show, not by lineId
Explains that the service charge is added by the account's rules and comes back unless dismissed
If it keeps the removal, the preview lists the charge under dismissedAutoCharges and nothing is saved before the user's yes

evals.prompt: Add <product> to the quote of <closed deal>.
evals.setup: <closed deal> is a test deal in an Approved or Denied stage.
evals.expected_output: Reads the deal, sees the end-of-flow stage, explains the quote is locked and stops.
expectations: Reports the blocker from show or preview
Does not call apply and does not try another way to write the quote

evals.prompt: Ponle a <product> en la cotización del negocio <deal> un 10% de descuento que se vaya perdiendo hasta el viernes a las 6 de la tarde. <other-product> ya tiene descuento.
evals.expected_output: Answers in Spanish. Sets discountRate 0.1 on that line only, turns on a Real-Time window ending Friday 18:00 in the user's time zone, previews, names the other discounted line as also under the clock, waits for a yes, applies with resolvedTimeDiscount and reports the saved total.
expectations: Uses timeDiscount with strategy Real-Time and endAt Friday 18:00 local
Changes the discount of the named product only
Tells the user the other discounted line falls under the same clock
Warns that reopening the deal after the end makes the discount 0
Waits for an explicit yes, then applies with resolvedTimeDiscount as timeDiscount
Reports only figures from preview or apply

evals.prompt: Give <product> on <deal> a 15% discount valid until next Monday at noon.
evals.expected_output: Asks whether the discount should end all at once (Limited-Time) or shrink over time (Real-Time) before building the plan; writes nothing.
expectations: Asks which strategy before previewing
Does not pick a strategy on its own
Writes nothing in this turn

evals.prompt: Quítale el límite de tiempo al descuento de la cotización de <deal>.
evals.expected_output: Plans timeDiscount off, previews and tells the user every line gets its full discount back with no end date (with the amounts), waits for a yes and applies.
expectations: Uses timeDiscount {"off": true}
Says every line gets its full discount back, with no end date
Does not change any line discount by hand

evals.prompt: Si el cliente de <deal> acepta mañana a las 10 de la mañana, ¿cuánto pagaría?
evals.expected_output: Explains the server only prices the current moment, gives today's figure from a preview or show if useful, describes the rule in words, and points to the quote builder's time-discount simulator; does not compute a future amount.
expectations: Does not state an amount for tomorrow at 10
Explains how the strategy reduces the discount, in words
Points to the quote builder's simulator

evals.prompt: Ponle un descuento de 10% hasta el domingo a <product> en <closed-deal>.
evals.expected_output: Finds the deal is in an end-of-flow stage, explains that the account rejects quote changes there unless an admin allowed it, and stops.
expectations: Reports the closing-stage blocker in plain words
Does not try another way to save
Writes nothing
